name: cinema
description: A complete local AI filmmaking Web App packaged with its own Cinema runtime.

shortDescription.en-US: A complete local AI filmmaking App with Canvas, Edit, and Deliver workspaces.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 包含画布、剪辑与交付工作台的完整本地 AI 影视应用。

longDescription.en-US: Install and run the complete anybox for cinema Web App from the Right Sidebar. The plugin carries its sandboxed Web build, local HTTP App Runtime, project initialization skill, and optional MCP helpers.
longDescription.zh-CN: 从右侧栏安装并运行完整的 anybox for cinema Web App。插件自带沙箱化 Web 构建、本地 HTTP App Runtime、项目初始化 Skill 与可选 MCP 工具。

defaultPrompt: Initialize this folder as an anybox for cinema project
Prepare a local cinema project structure
Create a storyboard with Text and Image nodes

mcpServers.name: anybox for cinema
mcpServers.description: Read and update local anybox for cinema projects using only Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas nodes. Interactive generation runs through the plugin App Runtime.
permissions: Reads Cinema project metadata, canvas state, and recent events from local project folders.
Creates and updates Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas nodes, valid edges, and viewport state after approval.
Writes Cinema canvas state to .anybox-cinema/canvas.json and command events to .anybox-cinema/events.jsonl.
Does not store provider credentials and does not run video provider adapters.

tools.name: cinema_get_project_summary
tools.title: Get Cinema Project Summary
tools.description: Read an initialized Cinema project's local summary, node counts, recent events, directory overview, and gaps.

tools.name: cinema_apply_command
tools.title: Apply Cinema Command
tools.description: Apply a validated four-node Cinema canvas command directly to local .anybox-cinema/canvas.json.

tools.name: cinema_create_storyboard
tools.title: Create Cinema Storyboard
tools.description: Create storyboard Text nodes with optional connected Image nodes on the Cinema canvas.

installReview: Runs a local Node.js MCP server bundled with the Cinema plugin.
Reads and writes the selected local project's .anybox-cinema planning files directly.
Accepts only Text, Image, Video, and Audio canvas node types.
The plugin also carries a separate local App Runtime for its interactive Web product.
Canvas write actions are configured to ask before execution.

skillPreviews.name: Initialize Cinema Project
skillPreviews.description: Initialize or repair an anybox for cinema project with the canonical four-node canvas model.
